description: This Java source file defines the LevelDBProvider class, a utility class for managing LevelDB instances within the Spark network package. It includes methods for initializing, version checking, and logging related to LevelDB databases.

classes.name: LevelDBProvider
classes.description: A utility class for managing LevelDB instances, including initialization, version control, and logging.

classes.name: LevelDBLogger
classes.description: A private static class implementing the LevelDB logger interface, forwarding logs to SparkLogger.

methods.name: initLevelDB
methods.description: Initializes a LevelDB database at the specified file location with given version and ObjectMapper, handling creation and version checks.

methods.name: initLevelDB (overloaded)
methods.description: Initializes a LevelDB database at the specified file location with default options, mainly for testing.

methods.name: checkVersion
methods.description: Checks the version of the LevelDB database against the provided StoreVersion, throws exception if incompatible.

methods.name: storeVersion
methods.description: Stores the specified StoreVersion into the LevelDB database.
